structure.unit: Personal Representatives and Administration of Estates
Liability of Representatives; Administrators De Bonis Non

law.catch_line: Action against surety of personal representative; procedure

text.section: An action may be brought against the surety of the personal representative for failure of the personal representative to discharge his duties faithfully if an execution on a judgment against a personal representative is returned unsatisfied.
The surety may plead any pleas and offer any evidence that the personal representative could have made or offered in an action against the surety of the personal representative for a devastavit.
